newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Casino Data reinstated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Casino Data reinstated.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it reinstated coverage of Casino Data Systems with intermediate- and long-term outperformer ratings.
--Analyst Steven Bernard said he set 1996 and 1997 earnings estimates of $0.60 and $0.90 a share, respectively.
--EVEREN set an intermediate price target of $20 and long-term of $26.
--The rating is based on "the company's improved earnings visibility from new products and an increasing base of recurring revenue," Bernard said.
